title: CNC — drill-down
description: One CNC in detail: state, OEE, faults and process parameters. Reached from the milling_center Andon board.

list.name: machine
list.label: Machine
list.query:
SELECT subltree(l.path, nlevel(l.path) - 2, nlevel(l.path))::text AS __text,
       l.path::text AS __value
FROM umh.location l
  JOIN umh.topic t ON t.location_id = l.location_id
  JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id
WHERE g.data_contract_name = '_cnc'
GROUP BY l.path
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: State
panels.description: The machine's current state. FAULT means a stopping fault is active.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT v.value_num AS value
FROM umh.value_cnc v
  JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id
  JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id
  JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id
WHERE l.path = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::ltree[])
  AND g.data_contract_name = '_cnc'
  AND g.virtual_path = '' AND g.name = 'state'
  AND $__timeFilter(v.ts)
ORDER BY v.ts DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: OEE
panels.description: Availability x quality over the dashboard window. Performance is not measured (no takt time in the contract) and is taken as 100%. The markers are 60% and 85%.

targets.rawSql:
WITH a AS (
  SELECT avg(CASE WHEN v.value_num = 10 OR v.value_num >= 50 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS avail
  FROM umh.value_cnc v
    JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id
    JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id
    JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id
  WHERE l.path = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::ltree[])
    AND g.data_contract_name = '_cnc'
    AND g.virtual_path = '' AND g.name = 'state'
    AND $__timeFilter(v.ts)
),
d AS (
  SELECT g.name AS tag, max(v.value_num) - min(v.value_num) AS delta
  FROM umh.value_cnc v
    JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id
    JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id
    JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id
  WHERE l.path = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::ltree[])
    AND g.data_contract_name = '_cnc'
    AND g.virtual_path = '' AND g.name IN ('good_count','scrap_count')
    AND $__timeFilter(v.ts)
  GROUP BY g.name
),
q AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN sum(delta) > 0
         THEN sum(delta) FILTER (WHERE tag = 'good_count') / sum(delta) END AS qual
  FROM d
)
SELECT a.avail * q.qual AS value FROM a, q

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT g.name AS tag, max(v.value_num) - min(v.value_num) AS delta
  FROM umh.value_cnc v
    JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (

panels.title: Machine state
panels.description: Every state the machine has been in over the window. Neighbouring identical samples are merged, so a bar is one continuous state.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT v.ts AS "time",
       CASE v.value_num::int
            WHEN 0   THEN 'idle'
            WHEN 10  THEN 'running'
            WHEN 20  THEN 'setup'
            WHEN 30  THEN 'FAULT'
            WHEN 40  THEN 'stopped'
            WHEN 70  THEN 'tool change'
            ELSE 'code ' || v.value_num::int::text END AS "state"
FROM umh.value_cnc v
  JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id
  JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id
  JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id
WHERE l.path = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::ltree[])
  AND g.data_contract_name = '_cnc'
  AND g.virtual_path = '' AND g.name = 'state'
  AND $__timeFilter(v.ts)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Fault log
panels.description: One row per fault code change, newest first. Codes come from the CNC profile: 101 tool break, 102 coolant low (warning), 103 spindle overload.

targets.rawSql:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT v.ts, v.value_num AS code,
         lag(v.value_num) OVER (ORDER BY v.ts) AS prev
  FROM umh.value_cnc v
    JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id
    JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id
    JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id
  WHERE l.path = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::ltree[])
    AND g.data_contract_name = '_cnc'
    AND g.virtual_path = '' AND g.name = 'fault_code'
    AND $__timeFilter(v.ts)
)
SELECT ts AS "time", code AS "code",
       CASE code WHEN 101 THEN 'tool break'
                 WHEN 102 THEN 'coolant low (warning)'
                 WHEN 103 THEN 'spindle overload'
                 ELSE 'unmapped code' END AS "fault"
FROM f
WHERE code <> 0 AND code IS DISTINCT FROM prev
ORDER BY ts DESC

panels.title: Spindle load, tool life, coolant level
panels.description: Spindle load, remaining tool life and coolant level share one axis because they share a unit. Coolant below 15% raises the 102 warning.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT v.ts AS "time",
       CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = '' THEN g.name
            ELSE g.virtual_path || '.' || g.name END AS metric,
       v.value_num AS value
FROM umh.value_cnc v
  JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id
  JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id
  JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id
WHERE l.path = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::ltree[])
  AND g.data_contract_name = '_cnc'
  AND (g.virtual_path, g.name) IN (('spindle','load_pct'), ('tool','life_pct'), ('coolant','level_pct'))
  AND $__timeFilter(v.ts)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Why the machine was not producing
Downtime by duration
panels.description: Every non-producing state in the window, ranked by how much time it cost. A FAULT episode is named by the code that caused it, so tool break and spindle overload are separate reasons rather than one red bucket.

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('5 seconds', v.ts) AS ts,
         max(CASE WHEN g.name = 'state'      THEN v.value_num END) AS st,
         max(CASE WHEN g.name = 'fault_code' THEN v.value_num END) AS code
  FROM umh.value_cnc v
    JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id
    JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id
    JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id
  WHERE l.path = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::ltree[])
    AND g.data_contract_name = '_cnc'
    AND g.virtual_path = '' AND g.name IN ('state','fault_code')
    AND $__timeFilter(v.ts)
  GROUP BY 1
),
r AS (
  SELECT ts,
         CASE
           WHEN st = 30 THEN CASE code::int
                               WHEN 101 THEN 'tool break'
                               WHEN 103 THEN 'spindle overload'
                               WHEN 102 THEN 'coolant low'
                               ELSE 'fault ' || coalesce(code::int::text, '?') END
           WHEN st = 20 THEN 'setup'
           WHEN st = 40 THEN 'stopped (manual)'
           WHEN st = 0  THEN 'idle'
           WHEN st = 70 THEN 'tool change'
           ELSE 'running'
         END AS reason
  FROM s
  WHERE st IS NOT NULL
),
seq AS (
  SELECT ts, reason, lead(ts) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS next_ts FROM r
),
isl AS (
  SELECT reason,
         extract(epoch FROM (coalesce(next_ts, now()) - ts)) AS secs,
         row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ts)
       - row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY reason ORDER BY ts) AS grp
  FROM seq
),
ep AS (
  SELECT reason, grp, sum(secs) AS secs FROM isl GROUP BY reason, grp
),
agg AS (
  SELECT reason, sum(secs) AS secs, count(*) AS episodes
  FROM ep WHERE reason <> 'running'
  GROUP BY reason
)
SELECT reason AS "reason", secs / 60.0 AS "minutes"
FROM agg
ORDER BY secs DESC

panels.title: Downtime by occurrence
panels.description: The same episodes counted instead of timed. The two rankings disagreeing is the useful part: many short stops is a different problem from one long one. Bars carry the state timeline's colours, so red is the same red as a FAULT.

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('5 seconds', v.ts) AS ts,
         max(CASE WHEN g.name = 'state'      THEN v.value_num END) AS st,
         max(CASE WHEN g.name = 'fault_code' THEN v.value_num END) AS code
  FROM umh.value_cnc v

    JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id
    JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id

    AND g.data_contract_name = '_cnc'
    AND g.virtual_path = '' AND g.name IN ('state','fault_code')
    AND $__timeFilter(v.ts)
  GROUP BY 1
),
r AS (
  SELECT ts,
         CASE
           WHEN st = 30 THEN CASE code::int
                               WHEN 101 THEN 'tool break'
                               WHEN 103 THEN 'spindle overload'
                               WHEN 102 THEN 'coolant low'
                               ELSE 'fault ' || coalesce(code::int::text, '?') END
           WHEN st = 20 THEN 'setup'
           WHEN st = 40 THEN 'stopped (manual)'
           WHEN st = 0  THEN 'idle'
           WHEN st = 70 THEN 'tool change'
           ELSE 'running'
         END AS reason
  FROM s
  WHERE st IS NOT NULL
),
seq AS (
  SELECT ts, reason, lead(ts) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS next_ts FROM r
),
isl AS (
  SELECT reason,
         extract(epoch FROM (coalesce(next_ts, now()) - ts)) AS secs,
         row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ts)
       - row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY reason ORDER BY ts) AS grp
  FROM seq
),
ep AS (
  SELECT reason, grp, sum(secs) AS secs FROM isl GROUP BY reason, grp
),
agg AS (
  SELECT reason, sum(secs) AS secs, count(*) AS episodes
  FROM ep WHERE reason <> 'running'
  GROUP BY reason
)
SELECT reason AS "reason", episodes AS "occurrences"
FROM agg
ORDER BY episodes DESC

panels.title: Downtime reasons
panels.description: The Pareto arithmetic behind the two charts: how often, how long in total, how long on average, and the running share of all downtime.

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('5 seconds', v.ts) AS ts,
         max(CASE WHEN g.name = 'state'      THEN v.value_num END) AS st,
         max(CASE WHEN g.name = 'fault_code' THEN v.value_num END) AS code
  FROM umh.value_cnc v
    JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id
    JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id
    JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id
  WHERE l.path = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::ltree[])
    AND g.data_contract_name = '_cnc'
    AND g.virtual_path = '' AND g.name IN ('state','fault_code')
    AND $__timeFilter(v.ts)
  GROUP BY 1
),
r AS (
  SELECT ts,
         CASE
           WHEN st = 30 THEN CASE code::int
                               WHEN 101 THEN 'tool break'
                               WHEN 103 THEN 'spindle overload'
                               WHEN 102 THEN 'coolant low'
                               ELSE 'fault ' || coalesce(code::int::text, '?') END
           WHEN st = 20 THEN 'setup'
           WHEN st = 40 THEN 'stopped (manual)'
           WHEN st = 0  THEN 'idle'
           WHEN st = 70 THEN 'tool change'
           ELSE 'running'
         END AS reason
  FROM s
  WHERE st IS NOT NULL
),
seq AS (
  SELECT ts, reason, lead(ts) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS next_ts FROM r
),
isl AS (
  SELECT reason,
         extract(epoch FROM (coalesce(next_ts, now()) - ts)) AS secs,
         row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ts)
       - row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY reason ORDER BY ts) AS grp
  FROM seq
),
ep AS (
  SELECT reason, grp, sum(secs) AS secs FROM isl GROUP BY reason, grp
),
agg AS (
  SELECT reason, sum(secs) AS secs, count(*) AS episodes
  FROM ep WHERE reason <> 'running'
  GROUP BY reason
),
tot AS (SELECT sum(secs) AS t FROM agg)
SELECT agg.reason AS "reason",
       agg.episodes AS "occurrences",
       agg.secs AS "total",
       agg.secs / agg.episodes AS "mean each",
       agg.secs / tot.t AS "share",
       sum(agg.secs) OVER (ORDER BY agg.secs DESC
                           ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) / tot.t AS "cumulative"
FROM agg, tot
ORDER BY agg.secs DESC

panels.title: Counters
panels.description: The raw monotonic counters. They only reset when the simulator restarts or the counter wraps, so read the slope, not the value.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT v.ts AS "time",
       CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = '' THEN g.name
            ELSE g.virtual_path || '.' || g.name END AS metric,
       v.value_num AS value
FROM umh.value_cnc v
  JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id
  JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id
  JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id
WHERE l.path = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::ltree[])
  AND g.data_contract_name = '_cnc'
  AND (g.virtual_path, g.name) IN (('','good_count'), ('','scrap_count'), ('','part_count'))
  AND $__timeFilter(v.ts)
ORDER BY 1
